integrity: The complete result, finite checker, exact proof, review, and verification limitations are bundled. The finite checker corroborates, rather than proves, the infinite-domain result.
scientific_limitations: The unrooted labelled Cayley-tree model counts all sibling-leaf pairs irrespective of center degree. No bivariate central limit theorem or independent historical priority assessment is asserted. General tree-pattern enumerators may contain equivalent implicit mixed moments; no independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: Exact cherry-size-biased leaf law in uniform labelled trees
